# Vendored FSRS

Pinned copy of [open-spaced-repetition/swift-fsrs](https://github.com/open-spaced-repetition/swift-fsrs) commit `d09cfc96c8f4c135ffc1905ac5627672906bf421` (2026-06 concurrency follow-up to the FSRS-6 merge). MIT license; see `LICENSE`.

There is no release tag after `v5.0.0` (FSRS-5, 2024-10-29). This commit is the selected exact version because it implements FSRS-6 and makes the public types `Sendable`. The app uses the library product only. Parameter fitting is not part of the app.
